objects.name: Detection technique coverage: getnettcpconnection-with-powershell
objects.description: The following analytic identifies the execution of `powershell.exe` with the `Get-NetTcpConnection` command, which lists current TCP connections on a system. This detection leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on process names and command-line executions. Monitoring this activity is significant as it may indicate an adversary or Red Team performing network reconnaissance or situational awareness.
